title: ‘Majestic Unicorn’: Rare Albino Buck With Huge Rack Captured In Viral Video
text:
(Photo by Jeffrey Phelps/Getty Images)

This has to be a top-tier good omen, right?

Some people like to view me as your average sports blogger, but I also have passions in other realms, which include weather, finance, hip-hop, and if I continued to list them, you would be confused as to how someone like me exists. I’ve got all different kinds of flavors.

One of the other realms happens to be nature, and it’s stories (and views) like the one today why I get so pumped about it. (RELATED: 8-Year-Old Fisherman Bizarrely Catches Piranha In Pennsylvania Lake)

@joelord_wi, a user on Instagram, posted footage recently that’s absolutely stunning. Currently going viral, the video shows an albino buck with a huge rack crossing a Wisconsin road.

“Well, I hope this was a good omen for fishing this week in the Wisconsin Northwoods. Can’t explain what it was like getting so close to such a majestic Unicorn! Wild Wisconsin, albino whitetail,” reads the video’s caption.

You can watch the original footage of the rare albino buck here.

WATCH:

Ahh you know - just a 200” albino walking across 🤯📸: Joe Lord pic.twitter.com/q9EdlpHQ9X

We talk about rare feats in sports all the time — a pristine shooting season, a pitcher tossing an immaculate inning, or a football team pulling off a miraculous Hail Mary as the clock hits triple zeros. But crossing paths with a full-blown albino buck carrying a massive rack?

That’s hitting an eight-leg parlay against the laws of biology. Biologists usually put the odds of an albino deer somewhere around 1-in-20,000, or 1-in-30,000, even 1-in-100,000, according to Deer Busters.

Seeing one that managed to survive predators, hunters, and winter elements long enough to grow a crown like that is basically nature’s version of winning the Powerball.

I need this kind of luck in my life; maybe I should take a trip to Wisconsin.
